script_nghe: And now the weekend forecast. Saturday will begin cloudy, with the temperature reaching twenty-six degrees in the afternoon. Sunday looks less pleasant — rain is expected all day. Drivers should also be careful of strong winds on Sunday evening. So if you’re planning a trip to the beach, Saturday is definitely your best choice.

> **Why cities are hotter**
> 
> Anyone who has walked through a city on a summer afternoon knows that it feels hotter than the countryside. Scientists call this the urban heat island effect. Concrete and asphalt absorb heat during the day and release it slowly at night, so city temperatures can stay up to five degrees higher after dark.
> 
> The effect is made worse by air conditioning, which cools buildings inside but pushes hot air into the street. Trees are the simplest solution: a street with mature trees can be several degrees cooler than one without. However, planting trees takes decades to have a real effect, and many growing cities are removing them to build roads instead.

**True / False / Not Given (6–8):**
6. Cities can be up to five degrees warmer than the countryside at night.
7. Air conditioning reduces the urban heat island effect.
8. Most cities have started planting more trees.

**Hoàn thành câu (9–11):**
9. Concrete and ____________ absorb heat during the day.
10. Streets with ____________ trees are cooler.

writing.de_tom_tat: Viết 60–70 từ mô tả thời tiết 4 mùa ở nơi bạn sống và mùa bạn thích nhất.
writing.bai_mau: Where I live there are only two real seasons. From May to October it rains almost every afternoon, and it is very humid. It is often raining when I leave the office. From November to April it is dry and sunny, and the evenings are cooler. I prefer the dry season because it is easier to go out and the sky is clear.

cham_diem.vi_sao: it rains · it is very humid · It is often raining · it is dry and sunny. Thời tiết luôn dùng chủ ngữ It, không được bỏ.
it rains (động từ, việc thường xảy ra) · it is raining (đang xảy ra) · và nếu dùng tính từ thì phải là “it is rainy”. Dùng đúng cả hai dạng.
Các mùa · đặc điểm từng mùa · mùa thích nhất kèm lý do.

dang_hoc: rain là động từ (it rains) · rainy là tính từ (it is rainy) · raining là dạng tiếp diễn (it is raining).
Thời tiết bắt buộc có chủ ngữ It — tiếng Việt nói “mưa rồi”, tiếng Anh phải là “It is raining”.
Hỏi thời tiết: What's the weather like? — chú ý có like ở cuối.
loi_thuong_gap: ❌ Today rains → ✅ It rains today / It is raining today
❌ It is rain → ✅ It is rainy (hoặc It is raining)
❌ How is the weather like? → ✅ What is the weather like?

speaking.de_tom_tat: What's the weather like today? / Which season do you prefer? Why? / Does the weather affect your mood?

cau_tra_loi.mau: It's hot and quite humid, around thirty-three degrees. It looks like it might rain later.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Thêm số độ cụ thể là chi tiết ăn điểm.

cau_tra_loi.hoi: Which season do you prefer? Why?
cau_tra_loi.mau: The dry season, definitely. It's easier to get around on a motorbike, and I can go cycling at the weekend without getting soaked.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: “definitely” thể hiện quan điểm rõ ràng — giám khảo đánh giá cao sự dứt khoát.

cau_tra_loi.hoi: Does the weather affect your mood?
cau_tra_loi.mau: Yes, quite a lot. When it rains for days I feel a bit lazy and I stay indoors. On sunny days I have much more energy.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: So sánh hai tình huống trái ngược là cách dễ nhất để nói dài mà vẫn có ý.

cham_diem.vi_sao: Đủ, có số liệu và so sánh.
humid /ˈhjuːmɪd/ — có âm /j/ đầu. weather /ˈweðə/ vs whether — đọc giống nhau.

meo_noi: “get soaked” = ướt sũng · “degrees” nhớ bật /z/ cuối.
Nhiệt độ: “around thirty-three degrees” — không cần nói Celsius, người ta hiểu.
